'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 European and Mediterranean wildfires]]
**At least ten firefighters and rescue workers are killed and 14 others are injured in a [[wildfire]] in [[Eskişehir Province]], [[Turkey]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/climate-and-environment/article/wildfire-kills-10-firefighters-and-rescue-workers-in-turkiye/ (CTV News)]
**Two people are killed and hundreds of others are evacuated in a fire in [[Limassol]], [[Cyprus]]. The fire brigade chief says the fire was [[arson]]. [https://greekreporter.com/2025/07/24/two-dead-massive-wildfire-cyprus/ (''Greek Reporter'')] [https://cyprus-mail.com/2025/07/24/limassol-fire-was-arson-fire-brigade-chief-says/ (''Cyprus Mail'')]
*[[2025 Pacific typhoon season]]
**One person is killed by [[Tropical Storm Wipha (2025)|Tropical Storm Wipha]] in [[Nghệ An province]], [[Vietnam]]. [https://apnews.com/article/vietnam-wipha-floods-storm-tropical-depression-thailand-acb758387590def29c37f8993598e03c (AP)]
*Six [[Northeastern University (China)|Northeastern University]] students are killed and one teacher is injured after the collapse of protective grates over a [[Froth flotation|flotation cell]] at the Wunugetushan [[gold mining|gold mine]] near [[Manzhouli]], [[Inner Mongolia]], [[China]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/six-college-students-china-drown-after-falling-into-mine-2025-07-24 (Reuters)] [https://www.scmp.com/news/china/article/3319371/6-students-chinese-university-drown-mine-processing-tank-inner-mongolia (''South China Morning Post'')]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023–2025 mpox epidemic]]
**[[The Gambia]] reports its first case of [[mpox]] and announces an [[outbreak]]. [https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/amp/gambia-declares-mpox-outbreak-211781 (''Hurriyet Daily News'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–India relations]]
**[[India]] announces it will [[Visa policy of India|resume issuing]] [[tourist visa]]s for [[China|Chinese]] citizens, ending a five-year suspension imposed following the [[2020 China–India skirmishes|2020 border skirmishes between the two countries]]. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/south-asia/india-to-resume-issuing-tourist-visas-to-chinese-citizens (''The Straits Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 University of Idaho murders]]
**Bryan Kohberger is sentenced to four consecutive [[life sentence]]s in prison without parole after pleading guilty to the murders of four [[University of Idaho]] students in 2022. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2025/07/23/us/kohberger-idaho-murders (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**A [[specialized court]] in [[Antioquia Department|Antioquia]], [[Colombia]], sentences seven former [[Chiquita]] executives to 135 months in prison and fines them [[Colombian peso|COP]]$13.876 billion (US$3.4 million) for financing the now-defunct [[United Self-Defense Forces of Colombia|AUC]] paramilitary group. [https://www.infobae.com/colombia/2025/07/23/historica-condena-justicia-colombiana-dicta-sentencia-contra-siete-directivos-de-chiquita-brands/ (''Infobae'')]
*A [[mass shooting]] in [[Maguiresbridge]], [[Northern Ireland]], leaves three people dead and another seriously injured. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cqx2537w5e2o (BBC News)]
*[[Indonesian National Police]] arrest 44 people suspected of [[arson|starting]] [[forest fire]]s across the country, which contribute to the [[Southeast Asian haze]]. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-forest-fires-arrests-smoke-environment-health-bfa93ff2ed819fdfcdca5da90e2a1010 (AP)]

**Lt. Governor [[David Apatang]] succeeds Palacios as [[Governor of the Northern Mariana Islands]]. [[Dennis C.
